 Follow Us On: News Education Today CBSE Class 10, 12 board exams 2027: Datesheet out, exams from February 16 CBSE Class 10, 12 board datesheet 2027 out; exams begin Feb 16: Subject-wise dates
 The CBSE Class 10, Class 12 board exam datesheet 2027 is out. The main CBSE Class 10 exams will be held from February 17 to March 9, while the main Class 12 exams will be from February 16 to April 1. Check the full CBSE datesheet here.
 Advertisement The CBSE Class 10, Class 12 board exam datesheet 2027 is out. Here is what Class 10 and 12 students need to know about the exam schedule and preparation timeline. (Photo: PTI) By: India Today News Desk Nov 6, 2026 20:07 IST Last Updated Nov 6, 2026 20:07 IST Published by Vivek Nov 6, 2026 19:09 IST The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the date sheet for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027. The examinations will begin on February 16, 2027, with both sets of board exams scheduled to start at 10:30 am.
 The CBSE board exam datesheet 2027 was issued on November 6, giving students 101 days to prepare before the examinations begin. According to the notification, more than 26.5 lakh students have registered for the CBSE Class 10 board exams, while over 19.8 lakh students will appear for the CBSE Class 12 board exams.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Class 10 students will appear in 83 subjects, while Class 12 students will take examinations in 121 subjects. CBSE CLASS 10 DATESHEET 2027: SUBJECT-WISE DATES
 The Class 10 examinations will begin with Painting on February 16, followed by Mathematics on February 17. The main academic papers, including Science, English and Social Science, are scheduled across February and March.

 All dates are for 2027. Examination timing is 10:30 am onwards. The language entries are grouped for readability; students should check their exact subject code in the official date sheet. CBSE CLASS 12 DATESHEET 2027: SUBJECT-WISE DATES
 The Class 12 timetable covers the major Science, Commerce and Humanities subjects. Physics is scheduled on the opening day of the examinations, while Chemistry and Accountancy will follow in February. Several other important papers, including Mathematics, English, Economics, Biology and Business Studies, are scheduled between March and April.

 Other notable Class 12 subjects: Physical Education, Entrepreneurship, Biotechnology, Mass Media Studies, Design Thinking and Innovation, Home Science and Legal Studies are also included in the date sheet. Environmental Science is not listed as a separate paper in the supplied notification.
 The tables are a reader-friendly selection of major subjects, not the complete timetable. Please cross-check the exact subject codes and dates against the original CBSE PDF before publication, particularly for regional-language combinations.
 Check the full CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 datesheets here: WHY CBSE'S 2027 DATESHEET RELEASE IS LATER THAN LAST YEAR
 The CBSE datesheet for the 2027 board examinations has been released on November 6, later than the timetable announcement last year. For the 2026 examinations, the Board had released a tentative datesheet on September 24, 2025, followed by the final schedule on October 30, 2025. This time, students have received the final timetable in November, without the same early tentative schedule announcement.
 CBSE has attributed the preparation of the timetable to the completion of the List of Candidates (LOC) submission by schools. The Board said it now has final data on the subject combinations selected by students. More than 40,000 subject combinations were considered while preparing the schedule to ensure that no two examinations opted for by an individual student clash.
 advertisement The Board has also factored in the tentative schedules of major entrance examinations for Class 12 students, gaps between commonly combined subjects, examination centre requirements and the availability of teachers during evaluation. WHAT STUDENTS SHOULD KNOW
 The early release of the timetable is expected to help students organise their preparation and reduce last-minute uncertainty. It will also allow families to plan travel and other engagements during the summer vacation around the examination and evaluation schedules.
 CBSE said the advance announcement would help schools plan academic support for board classes and make arrangements at examination centres. It would also help ensure that teachers are not away from schools for prolonged periods during the evaluation process, allowing academic activities for non-board classes to continue.
 Students can access the date sheet through the official CBSE website, cbse.gov.in or check the direct link here.
